caption: This shio broth ramen features a golden-yellow, glossy, clear soup with thin noodles and floating ingredients. In a cream-colored ceramic bowl with black geometric pattern, a halved egg, dark green nori, and tender pale pink chashu pork are served on a warm brown wooden table.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain pattern, and subtle natural texture.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with glossy surface and irregular, slightly curled shape.
The nori seaweed is dark green, crinkled, and irregularly shaped with a slightly glossy, textured surface.
The shio (salt) broth is golden-yellow, glossy, and clear, with thin noodles submerged and floating ingredients visible.
A halved boiled egg shows a runny orange yolk surrounded by a pale white, with a slightly textured surface.
Cream-colored ceramic bowl with black geometric pattern and slightly raised rim, smooth surface.
